source_refs.note: Topic 1.13 Network Load Balancing as printed up to its first sub-heading (PDF 19, printed 14); the sub-headings are their own lessons.

blocks.text: Network load balancing is used to manage network traffic. It distributes work among multiple servers or links. This helps prevent overloading of one device. Load balancing improves network speed and reliability. It is used in large networks and data centers. Proper load balancing ensures smooth performance. It helps networks handle more users.
